title: China-to-Myanmar BESS Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.target_requirement: Myanmar does not have an EU-style battery regulation for industrial BESS. For battery energy storage systems, MSTRD conformity evidence may be requested where the product falls within a regulated or standards-assessed category, while MS or IEC-based evidence such as IEC 62619 and IEC 62933 is commonly more relevant than a purely China GB report.
target_standards: Myanmar Standards Law and MSTRD conformity practice
Myanmar Standards based on IEC where adopted
rows.china_equivalent: Common China BESS evidence is typically built around GB/T 36276 for lithium-ion batteries for energy storage, GB 4943.1 for electrical safety where applicable, and GB/T 34131 for grid-connected energy storage converter requirements.
rows.gap: China GB reports may help describe design and test basis but may not be accepted as Myanmar conformity evidence if MSTRD or a project owner asks for MS or IEC alignment.

mandatory_status.target: Mostly voluntary standards; conformity evidence may be required where the product category, importer, tender, or authority brings the BESS in scope.
mandatory_status.cn: China baseline normally uses GB/T 36276, GB 4943.1 where applicable, and GB/T 34131; market enforcement depends on product configuration and project context.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Prepare an IEC 62619 and IEC 62933 mapping pack rather than assuming a China GB/T 36276 report alone will satisfy Myanmar buyers or authorities.

source.publisher: Ministry of Science and Technology / MSTRD

rows.requirement: No Horizontal Battery Carbon Footprint or Battery Passport Regime
rows.target_requirement: Myanmar has no known horizontal battery carbon footprint declaration, battery passport, or EU Battery Regulation-style lifecycle reporting regime for BESS. Carbon or lifecycle data may still be requested contractually by lenders, international project sponsors, or ESG procurement programs.
target_standards: No horizontal Myanmar battery carbon footprint regulation identified
Contractual ESG or lender requirements may apply by project
rows.china_equivalent: Common China BESS evidence is typically built around GB/T 36276 for lithium-ion batteries for energy storage, GB 4943.1 for electrical safety where applicable, and GB/T 34131 for grid-connected energy storage converter requirements.
rows.gap: Unlike the EU template, there is no Myanmar legal equivalent to carbon footprint declarations or battery passport duties. The gap is contractual readiness, not a general Myanmar statutory duty.

mandatory_status.target: Not horizontally mandatory in Myanmar; may be project-specific by contract or financing terms.
mandatory_status.cn: China baseline normally uses GB/T 36276, GB 4943.1 where applicable, and GB/T 34131; carbon footprint evidence is separate from this baseline.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not import EU Battery Regulation carbon-footprint obligations into the Myanmar column; treat them as lender or buyer add-ons unless a specific tender requires them.

source.publisher: Ministry of Science and Technology / MSTRD

rows.target_requirement: Myanmar BESS imports should keep English technical documentation, nameplate data, safety instructions, SDS, test reports, and installation manuals available for importer, customs, MSTRD, utility, and project-owner review. Specific labeling format requirements may be set by the importer, tender, customs classification, or dangerous-goods shipment route.
target_standards: UN lithium battery mark and Class 9 label for transport where applicable
rows.china_equivalent: Common China BESS evidence is typically built around GB/T 36276 for lithium-ion batteries for energy storage, GB 4943.1 for electrical safety where applicable, and GB/T 34131 for grid-connected energy storage converter requirements.
rows.gap: Chinese domestic labels and Chinese-language manuals alone are usually insufficient for Myanmar import and project review. English documentation and clear model traceability should be prepared.

mandatory_status.target: Documentation is practically required for import, customs, conformity, utility, and project review; exact legal format depends on product scope and route.
mandatory_status.cn: China baseline normally uses GB/T 36276, GB 4943.1 where applicable, and GB/T 34131; domestic labeling alone should not be treated as Myanmar-ready.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Build a bilingual or English technical dossier with model numbers matching invoices, packing lists, test reports, and nameplates.

rows.requirement: No Horizontal RoHS Restriction for BESS
rows.target_requirement: Myanmar has no horizontal RoHS regime equivalent to EU RoHS for BESS or general electrical equipment. Hazardous-substance limits may still appear through buyer specifications, lender ESG requirements, waste rules, or imported-equipment contracts, but they should not be described as a general Myanmar RoHS legal obligation.
target_standards: No horizontal Myanmar RoHS regime identified
rows.china_equivalent: Common China BESS evidence is typically built around GB/T 36276 for lithium-ion batteries for energy storage, GB 4943.1 for electrical safety where applicable, and GB/T 34131 for grid-connected energy storage converter requirements.
rows.gap: There is no Myanmar statutory RoHS gap to close. The practical gap is whether the buyer or financer imports EU-style substance requirements into the contract.

mandatory_status.cn: China baseline normally uses GB/T 36276, GB 4943.1 where applicable, and GB/T 34131; China RoHS or material declarations are separate from this BESS baseline.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] State plainly that Myanmar lacks a horizontal RoHS regime; provide substance declarations only when requested by contract, lender, or purchaser.

source.publisher: Ministry of Science and Technology / MSTRD

rows.requirement: Fire Safety and Thermal Runaway Controls
rows.target_requirement: Myanmar BESS projects should document thermal runaway prevention, fire detection, suppression, spacing, ventilation, emergency shutdown, and site fire-response procedures. Local fire authority, project owner, insurer, or lender requirements may determine the accepted evidence, often referencing IEC 62933 system safety and internationally recognized fire-test data.
target_standards: Local fire authority and insurer requirements
rows.china_equivalent: Common China BESS evidence is typically built around GB/T 36276 for lithium-ion batteries for energy storage, GB 4943.1 for electrical safety where applicable, and GB/T 34131 for grid-connected energy storage converter requirements.
rows.gap: China GB/T 36276 evidence may not include the project-level fire scenario, emergency response, ventilation, and thermal propagation evidence required by Myanmar site approvers or international financiers.

mandatory_status.target: Project-specific; may be required by local fire authority, owner, insurer, lender, or utility even where standards are voluntary.
mandatory_status.cn: China baseline normally uses GB/T 36276, GB 4943.1 where applicable, and GB/T 34131; site fire approval is project-specific.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat fire safety as a site-approval package, not only a cell test report; include layout, ventilation, suppression, shutdown, SDS, and emergency response evidence.

source.publisher: Ministry of Science and Technology / MSTRD

rows.target_requirement: Myanmar uses 230 V, 50 Hz supply. The 50 Hz frequency aligns with China, but nominal voltage differs from China's common 220/380 V basis. Utility acceptance for BESS grid interconnection should be confirmed with MEPE or ESE because grid rules for storage are evolving and project-specific.
rows.china_equivalent: Common China BESS evidence is typically built around GB/T 36276 for lithium-ion batteries for energy storage, GB 4943.1 for electrical safety where applicable, and GB/T 34131 for grid-connected energy storage converter requirements.
rows.gap: The main gap is not frequency but utility acceptance: China PCS reports should be checked against Myanmar's 230 V nominal system, protection settings, anti-islanding, power quality, and MEPE/ESE interconnection studies.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for grid-connected projects through utility approval or interconnection agreement; details are project-specific.
mandatory_status.cn: China baseline normally uses GB/T 36276, GB 4943.1 where applicable, and GB/T 34131; China grid settings should not be assumed acceptable in Myanmar.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Confirm 230 V, 50 Hz design settings and obtain MEPE or ESE interconnection acceptance before treating a China grid-connection report as Myanmar-ready.

source.publisher: Myanmar Ministry of Electric Power / MEPE and ESE context

rows.requirement: MIC Import Permit for Large BESS Systems
rows.target_requirement: Large BESS projects or project equipment may require import permit handling through the Myanmar Investment Commission or related investment and customs channels. Importers should confirm permit need, HS classification, project approval linkage, and supporting technical documents before shipment.
target_standards: MIC import permit and investment approval practice
rows.china_equivalent: Common China BESS evidence is typically built around GB/T 36276 for lithium-ion batteries for energy storage, GB 4943.1 for electrical safety where applicable, and GB/T 34131 for grid-connected energy storage converter requirements.
rows.gap: A China product certificate is not an import permit. The gap is administrative: local importer identity, permit route, HS code, project approval linkage, and customs documentation must be arranged before shipment.

mandatory_status.target: Potentially mandatory for large systems or project imports; confirm with MIC, importer, and customs broker.
mandatory_status.cn: China baseline normally uses GB/T 36276, GB 4943.1 where applicable, and GB/T 34131; export-side evidence does not replace Myanmar import approval.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Lock the Myanmar importer, MIC route, HS code, and permit evidence before booking shipment for a large BESS.

source.publisher: Directorate of Investment and Company Administration / Myanmar Investment Commission

rows.requirement: MSTRD Conformity Documents for Regulated Categories
rows.target_requirement: Myanmar standards are largely voluntary, but some regulated categories need conformity documents. For BESS, the importer should check whether MSTRD conformity assessment, test-report acceptance, or MS/IEC evidence is requested for the specific cabinet, PCS, battery module, or integrated system.
target_standards: Applicable Myanmar Standards or IEC standards
rows.china_equivalent: Common China BESS evidence is typically built around GB/T 36276 for lithium-ion batteries for energy storage, GB 4943.1 for electrical safety where applicable, and GB/T 34131 for grid-connected energy storage converter requirements.
rows.gap: The uncertainty is scope. China reports should be mapped to each imported component because Myanmar conformity review may look at the integrated system and not only the battery cell or module.

mandatory_status.target: Voluntary unless the category, authority, importer, tender, or project approval makes conformity documents required.
mandatory_status.cn: China baseline normally uses GB/T 36276, GB 4943.1 where applicable, and GB/T 34131; scope mapping is needed for Myanmar.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Ask the importer to obtain an MSTRD scope view for the exact BESS bill of materials before assuming voluntary standards mean no documentation.

source.publisher: Ministry of Science and Technology / MSTRD

rows.target_requirement: If a BESS includes cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, LoRa, or other radio telemetry modules, Myanmar radio approval may be required through MPT or the responsible telecommunications authority. Non-radio BESS electrical conformity does not cover radio spectrum authorization.
target_standards: Myanmar radio or telecommunications equipment approval practice
MPT or telecommunications authority requirements for radio modules
rows.china_equivalent: Common China BESS evidence is typically built around GB/T 36276 for lithium-ion batteries for energy storage, GB 4943.1 for electrical safety where applicable, and GB/T 34131 for grid-connected energy storage converter requirements.
rows.gap: China SRRC or module certificates do not automatically authorize radio use in Myanmar. The radio module list, bands, output power, and local approval route should be checked separately from BESS safety.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory if radio transmitting modules are imported or operated; not applicable to non-radio configurations.
mandatory_status.cn: China baseline normally uses GB/T 36276, GB 4943.1 where applicable, and GB/T 34131; radio approval is separate.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Separate the BESS electrical dossier from radio-module approval; list every transmitting module and confirm Myanmar authorization before import.

rows.target_requirement: For Myanmar BESS projects, IEC 62619 evidence for secondary lithium cells and batteries for industrial applications is a practical anchor where MSTRD, buyers, utilities, or lenders ask for internationally recognized battery safety documentation.
target_standards: Myanmar Standards based on IEC where adopted
rows.china_equivalent: Common China BESS evidence is typically built around GB/T 36276 for lithium-ion batteries for energy storage, GB 4943.1 for electrical safety where applicable, and GB/T 34131 for grid-connected energy storage converter requirements.
rows.gap: GB/T 36276 is relevant but not a substitute for an IEC 62619 report if the Myanmar counterparty asks for IEC or MS-aligned evidence.

mandatory_status.target: Usually voluntary or project-driven; may become required by MSTRD scope, tender, lender, utility, or buyer specifications.
mandatory_status.cn: China baseline normally uses GB/T 36276, GB 4943.1 where applicable, and GB/T 34131.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Keep IEC 62619 evidence ready for cells and modules; map it to GB/T 36276 results instead of presenting the China report alone.

rows.target_requirement: IEC 62933 is the practical international reference for system-level BESS safety, including hazard identification, controls, protection functions, thermal runaway risk, and safe operation. Myanmar project stakeholders may request IEC 62933 evidence even when local standards are not strictly mandatory.
target_standards: Project owner and utility safety requirements
rows.china_equivalent: Common China BESS evidence is typically built around GB/T 36276 for lithium-ion batteries for energy storage, GB 4943.1 for electrical safety where applicable, and GB/T 34131 for grid-connected energy storage converter requirements.
rows.gap: China component-level evidence may not prove integrated system safety, BMS/PCS coordination, fault handling, safe isolation, emergency shutdown, or installation controls expected in a Myanmar project dossier.

mandatory_status.target: Project-specific; often required by utility, owner, lender, insurer, or tender even if standards are voluntary.
mandatory_status.cn: China baseline normally uses GB/T 36276, GB 4943.1 where applicable, and GB/T 34131; integrated system evidence may require extra mapping.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Prepare a system-level IEC 62933 safety matrix covering BMS, PCS, protection, thermal controls, alarms, shutdown, and installation assumptions.

rows.requirement: Electrical Safety for PCS, Cabinets, and Controls
rows.target_requirement: Myanmar review of BESS electrical equipment may look at shock protection, insulation, creepage, clearances, earthing, short-circuit withstand, temperature rise, cabinet ingress protection, and control-equipment safety. IEC-based evidence may be requested for PCS, switchgear, controls, and auxiliary equipment.
target_standards: IEC electrical safety standards as applicable to equipment type
rows.china_equivalent: Common China BESS evidence is typically built around GB/T 36276 for lithium-ion batteries for energy storage, GB 4943.1 for electrical safety where applicable, and GB/T 34131 for grid-connected energy storage converter requirements.
rows.gap: GB 4943.1 may cover parts of electrical safety but may not match all IEC evidence requested for power conversion, switchgear, installation, and cabinet design in Myanmar projects.

mandatory_status.target: Depends on product scope, conformity review, utility requirements, and project specifications.
mandatory_status.cn: China baseline normally uses GB/T 36276, GB 4943.1 where applicable, and GB/T 34131; additional IEC electrical-safety mapping may be needed.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not stop at the battery report; include PCS, cabinet, protection, grounding, and control-equipment evidence in the Myanmar dossier.

source.publisher: Ministry of Science and Technology / MSTRD

rows.target_requirement: Lithium cells and batteries in BESS modules shipped to Myanmar should have UN Manual of Tests and Criteria, Part III, Section 38.3 evidence, with test summaries available to carriers and customs. This applies regardless of whether the shipment enters through Yangon, Thilawa, or Mandalay overland routes.
target_standards: UN Manual of Tests and Criteria, Part III, Section 38.3
UN 3480 or UN 3481 classification as applicable
Carrier and Myanmar customs dangerous-goods documentation practice
rows.china_equivalent: Common China BESS evidence is typically built around GB/T 36276 for lithium-ion batteries for energy storage, GB 4943.1 for electrical safety where applicable, and GB/T 34131 for grid-connected energy storage converter requirements.
rows.gap: UN 38.3 is shared internationally, so the technical test is not the main gap. The gap is shipment-level traceability: the report, test summary, model numbers, SDS, invoice, and packing list must match the actual cells or modules shipped.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory in practice for lithium battery dangerous-goods carriage and customs/carrier acceptance.
mandatory_status.cn: China baseline normally uses GB/T 36276, GB 4943.1 where applicable, and GB/T 34131; UN 38.3 transport evidence is separate and still required for shipment.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Keep UN 38.3 test summaries tied to the exact shipped cell and module models; China product safety reports alone are not transport documents.

rows.requirement: Dangerous Goods Routing via Yangon, Thilawa, or Mandalay
rows.target_requirement: BESS lithium battery shipments may enter Myanmar through Yangon or Thilawa by sea, or Mandalay overland. The shipment should be classified under the correct UN number, packaged and labelled as lithium batteries, supported by SDS and emergency information, and cleared through a broker familiar with local dangerous-goods handling.
target_standards: UN 3481 lithium ion batteries contained in or packed with equipment
ADR or applicable road dangerous-goods rules for overland transport
Myanmar customs and port handling practice
rows.china_equivalent: Common China BESS evidence is typically built around GB/T 36276 for lithium-ion batteries for energy storage, GB 4943.1 for electrical safety where applicable, and GB/T 34131 for grid-connected energy storage converter requirements.
rows.gap: Chinese export documents must be converted into a route-specific dangerous-goods pack for Myanmar entry, including port or border handling requirements and local customs broker instructions.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory in practice for dangerous-goods logistics and customs clearance; route-specific handling may vary.
mandatory_status.cn: China baseline normally uses GB/T 36276, GB 4943.1 where applicable, and GB/T 34131; route-specific dangerous-goods documents are separate.

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Choose the Myanmar entry route early and prepare the dangerous-goods pack for that route, especially for Yangon, Thilawa, or Mandalay overland clearance.
